stem:
At a science fair in Mysuru, Tushar builds a simple Solar System model. His teacher asks why Earth's distance from the Sun matters for life.

Which answer is best?

options.text: Earth is the largest planet, so it can hold more water.
Earth is at a distance where temperatures allow water to stay liquid.
Earth is the fastest planet, so its water never freezes.
Any distance from the Sun would still keep water liquid on Earth.

teacher.key_rationale: Earth's orbital distance gives a temperature range where liquid water can exist, which supports habitability. A and C replace that reason with unrelated properties; D drops the too-hot/too-cold boundary.
